current_source_findings: ComboAction performs bBlockable + frontal dot>=0 then TargetASC.TryGuardHit(StaminaDamage,Avatar); true suppresses ordinary HP/Stamina GE.
ASC only dispatches to an already-active UKZGuardAbility. Existing SwordShield grants lack that Player held-input guard.
UKZGuardAbility depends on IsGuardInputHeld/GuardStateHandle/State.Guarding and Player montage sections; directly granting it is not an autonomous shield policy.
Current AKZMonster prioritizes HP0 death over stamina0 exhaustion after GE coalescing. Existing exhaustion and death cleanup must remain authoritative.
confirmed_vs_inference: Serialized LockOn MoveDamageType=SystemGuard strongly identifies passive shielding mode; exact native predicate remains unverified.
Serialized attack notify windows contradict a universal original-game no-guard-while-attacking rule. Excluding all attacks in the first implementation is an explicit narrower project scope.
GuardReaction Hit and End preserve SystemGuard and reenter Hit on another SystemGuard event; ordinary wound reaction and guard-success reaction must be distinguished.
Existing frontal hemisphere dot>=0 can be a small project policy. It is consistent with interpreting raw180 as a full cone, but that interpretation is not native proof.
unconfirmed: Exact full/half-angle interpretation and world-space direction computation of SystemGuardFrontAngle180/active FrontAngle60.
Native unblockable damage-type/flag allowlist, damage reduction/chip HP formula, guard stamina rate consumption/divisor and whether rate1.8 multiplies current absolute window StaminaDamage.
Native default values of omitted properties, including reset-at-end fields not serialized.
Exact attacker reaction value30 comparison, passive event ordering/counter reset semantics and whether it means >=30.
Original native death/exhaustion/SystemGuard precedence: Common_Damage_Guts holding/death function-name metadata is not bytecode execution order.
Raw attack guard intervals require existing dilation/current montage conversion before implementation; notify assignment is not observed guard approval.

minimal_implementation_recommendation.owner: Existing CharacterDefinition editable shield/reaction settings + AKZMonster synchronous shield approval + the finite monster reaction Ability already being implemented for real reactions. No always-running copied Guard state or new manager.
minimal_implementation_recommendation.entry: Extend existing target ASC TryGuardHit fallback for eligible AKZMonster, retain Player active Guard handling and ComboAction bBlockable/front gate. Accepted shield consumes stamina through existing instant GE once with HP magnitude0, returns true even if later presentation aborts; otherwise false preserves normal hit.
minimal_implementation_recommendation.eligibility: Shield enabled, authority, valid source, positive HP and Stamina, no Dead/Exhausted, combat target/LockOn policy; first scope idle/standoff and own shield-success reaction only; reject ordinary attack/wound reaction/air/down/brutal. Derive from existing ASC Ability/tag/target/Locomotion state, do not duplicate writable AI phase.
minimal_implementation_recommendation.presentation: Use current Guard_GuardReaction_Hit then Guard_GuardReaction_End in the finite reaction owner. Further accepted shield hits restart Hit. Own Task/constraint cleanup; death/exhaustion cancel it; do not cancel/refill exhaustion or override ordinary Player Guard.
minimal_implementation_recommendation.stamina: Editable guard cost scaling remains a project decision; raw CS1.8 can inform a provisional multiplier but is not verified conversion. Preserve monster no-auto-regen/no-attack-cost. Stamina depletion delegates into existing Exhaustion rather than treating guard reaction Broken as the same native event.
minimal_implementation_recommendation.deferred_original_features: Active Guard Start/Loop and cooldown/rate spend, attack-partial SystemGuard notify windows, passive weapon/reaction-value Broken branches, original unblockable type matrix. Current AttackWindows.bBlockable=false remains project unblockable bypass.

current_system_guard_windows.formula: Original AC notify time -> saved DilationCurve interpolation baked seconds; clamp event to current clip bounds; absolute montage position=segment StartPos+(baked local seconds/segment AnimPlayRate); StartPos=sum(previous clip lengths/segment rate*loop count). All four current SwordShield attack clips have RateScale=1, segment rate=1, loop count=1.

current_system_guard_windows.overlap_policy: SwordCombo Step1 exports7 and8 overlap; runtime union [0,.4480854862701863] is equivalent within recorded intervals; preserve provenance rows separately.
current_system_guard_windows.branch_limit: SwordCombo Step1 Command edge may jump at .7774296450818909 to Step2. Its late guard interval is reachable only if current actual execution remains in Step1; query current playing montage + active Node and absolute asset position, not elapsed wall time.
current_system_guard_windows.precision_limit: Original Notifies EndLink and LinkValue+Duration sometimes differ at float precision. Saved event table used LinkValue+Duration. Preserve both raw values. Clip-bound clamp resolves endpoint beyond current GetPlayLength. No trigger-offset gameplay assumption.
current_system_guard_windows.native_limit: DamageType notify omitted bResetCustomDamageTypeAtNotifyEnd default and explicit false may persist mode beyond notify lifetime in native implementation. These mapped finite windows reproduce recorded intervals only; full original predicate/reset semantics remain unverified.
